units.title: Model Manager Requirements Scope
units.description: The functional requirements specification defines the functional or high-level user requirements for the Model Manager software tool.

source_references.excerpt: This document defines the functional or high-lever user requirements for the Model Manager software tool.

units.title: Model Back End System Composition
units.description: A model back end system consists of configuration files, data input, scripts, and executables required to run model jobs.

source_references.excerpt: a term describing configuration files, data input, scripts and executables that are needed to run model jobs

units.title: Model Job Scope and Function
units.description: A model job is a collection of processes computing a weather or climate model over a specified domain and time period.

source_references.excerpt: a collection of processes computing a weather or climate model over a given domain and for a given time period

units.title: Climo Job Classification
units.description: A climo job is defined as either a ClimoFDDA job (GCAT) or a CAM job.

source_references.excerpt: either a “ClimoFDDA”-job (GCAT) or a CAM job

units.title: GMOD Job Definition
units.description: A GMOD job is defined as the current operational RTFDDA job utilizing MM5 or WRF.

source_references.excerpt: the current operational RTFDDA job using MM5 or WRF

units.title: RTFDDA Job Composition
units.description: An RTFDDA job consists of either a GMOD job or an RTFDDA ensemble.

source_references.excerpt: a GMOD job or a RTFDDA ensemble

units.title: Off-line FDDA Job Classification
units.description: An off-line FDDA job is defined as a re-run of a previous RTFDDA cycle or a case study.

source_references.excerpt: a re-run of a previous RTFDDA cycle or a case study.
